firm_data.firm_description: Gemini Law LLP is a life sciences law firm that offers world-class biopharma IP litigation & strategy at a sensible cost. They have mastered the use of remote-work tools to handle complex legal challenges and provide substantial cost savings.
notable_facts: Innovative and cost-effective structure with attorneys working remotely with very little overhead.
Particular expertise in patent strategy and litigation relating to biosimilar, biobetter, generic and 505(b)(2) products.
Experienced in counseling early-stage biotech companies.
technology_signals: Mastered the use of remote-work tools

email.subject: AI for Gemini Law LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Robert,

Your remote-work infrastructure at Gemini Law is exactly the kind of lean, efficient model that's reshaping how boutique firms compete. You've already mastered what most firms struggle with: delivering world-class biopharma IP litigation without the overhead.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York market to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
